title: Language Models Predict Empathy Gaps Between Social In-groups and Out-groups

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning racial and ethnic group identities to the LLM persona (the perceiver) and the subject of a narrative (the experiencer) to measure the gap in predicted emotion intensity between in-group and out-group configurations.

Assigning different nationalities to the LLM persona and the narrative experiencer to evaluate differences in the model's predicted emotion intensities across in-group versus out-group relationships, as well as historical conflicts.

Assigning religious identities to the LLM persona and the narrative experiencer to calculate an intergroup empathy gap score based on the predicted emotion intensity of in-group versus out-group pairs.
